title: Visibility Modifiers
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of visibility modifiers using at least one correct term from the lesson.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Visibility Modifiers** as part of **Classes, Objects, and Object-Oriented Fundamentals**. Apply visibility modifiers by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—public and private, protected and internal, Visibility in Multi-Module Projects—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.
